<div class="card-body">
'''Echo Base Trooper''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">エコー基地兵員</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ホス以外の位置では戦闘力－１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Echo-Base-Trooper-PSA-160326792.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">エコー基地の防衛部隊は全員、熟練の戦士たちだ。ジェス・アラシェインのような兵員は、寒冷地で帝国軍の戦法に対抗できるように訓練を受けている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Echo Base trooper.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. After that, may move anywhere. Power -1 at locations other than Hoth.

'''Lore:'''
Everyone in Echo Base's garrison is a veteran warrior. Troopers such as Jess Allashane are trained to counter Imperial tactics in the cold.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Base Trooper]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
